name: Warden of the Grove

abilities.text: At the beginning of your end step, put a +1/+1 counter on ~.
Whenever another nontoken creature you control enters, it endures X, where X is the number of counters on ~.

notes: Endure is the keyword-action family op (CR 701.64a); X is `counters-on-source-any`, every counter kind on this creature, which is what "the number of counters on this creature" means.
